Verify the clickability of product image thumbnails
Investigated live 2026-07-23: this theme's gallery has no separate clickable thumbnail strip — it's a <slideshow-slide> web component where all slides render in the DOM but only the active one is positioned on-screen (rest are off-canvas), and Playwright's visibility check doesn't recognize any of them as visible, including the active one.
